tool_input.description: Inspect users feature and UI components

result:
I've added role filtering, name/email search and an Export CSV button to the users page in `apps/react-vite`. As you asked, I didn't run tests, lint, type-check or the app, so none of this has been checked yet.

**How it works:**
- **Filters:** above the table there is a search box (matches first name + last name, or email, ignoring case) and a role dropdown (All roles / Admin / User). The table updates as you type or pick a role.
- **Filtering happens in the browser:** the users endpoint already returns every user in one response, so I filter that list rather than adding query parameters to the API.
- **Export CSV:** downloads `users.csv` with the rows currently shown, with columns Name, Email, Role and Joined. The date uses the app's existing date format, so it includes the time. The button is disabled when no users match.
- **Admins only:** the page was already limited to admins, so the new controls are too.

**Changes:**
- `src/features/users/api/get-users.ts`: added the filter schema and its type, plus a `filterUsers` helper that applies the filters to the list.
- `src/features/users/components/users-list.tsx`: added the filter form, the Export CSV button, and the table now shows the filtered list.
- `src/utils/csv.ts` (new): builds the CSV text and triggers the download. It also blocks spreadsheet formula injection: a value starting with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` gets a leading `'`. One side effect is that an empty value or a value starting with `-` will show that `'` in the file.
- `src/components/ui/form/form.tsx`: added an optional `onChange` prop that reports the current values on every edit. The shared `Form` only reported values on submit, so live filtering needed this. Existing forms don't use it and behave as before.

The role filter compares `user.role` with the selected role. This only filters the list and doesn't control access, so I didn't route it through `Authorization`/`checkAccess`.
